input.quote: SFJ may, in its sole discretion, terminate this Agreement in its entirety at any time following a Change of Control of PB that occurs prior to the date of payment by PB of the final Approval Payment.
input.rationale: Section 14.2.6 gives SFJ a sole-discretion right to terminate the entire Agreement following a Change of Control of PB (broadly defined at p0036–p0037) and triggers an accelerated payment of 150% of Development Costs — the walk-away case under this rule. Section 15.6 also fails the preferred position: the consent-free Affiliate/successor proviso is mutual (so SFJ may assign without PB's consent), consent is not subject to a reasonableness standard, and there is no bar on assignment to a PB competitor (the p0817 restriction is category-limited and lapses at Program Transfer). We therefore make SFJ's change-of-control termination right a prohibition, narrow the free assignment proviso to PB, add "which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld", and add a competitor bar on SFJ assignment; PB's existing Affiliate/merger/stock-sale/asset-sale carve-out is preserved unchanged.

ops.oldText: SFJ may, in its sole discretion, terminate this Agreement in its entirety at any time following a Change of Control of PB
ops.newText: SFJ may not terminate this Agreement in its entirety at any time following a Change of Control of PB

ops.oldText: Without the prior written consent of the other Party hereto, neither Party will sell, transfer, assign
ops.newText: Without the prior written consent of the other Party hereto, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld, neither Party will sell, transfer, assign

ops.oldText: provided, however, that either Party may assign, sublicense or transfer this Agreement
ops.newText: provided, however, that PB may assign, sublicense or transfer this Agreement

ops.text: In no event will SFJ sell, assign, sublicense or otherwise transfer this Agreement or any of its rights or duties hereunder to a competitor of PB.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We turned SFJ's sole-discretion change-of-control termination right in Section 14.2.6 into a prohibition, and in Section 15.6 we limited the consent-free Affiliate/successor assignment right to PB, made consent subject to a not-unreasonably-withheld standard, and barred SFJ from assigning to a PB competitor. Our playbook does not permit a counterparty exit on our change of control or unrestricted Vendor assignment.
proposal.summary: Remove SFJ's change-of-control termination right; limit the free affiliate/successor assignment right to PB, add a reasonableness standard on consent, and bar SFJ assignment to a PB competitor.
